end.summary:
Practised identifying what common animals eat as plant-eaters, meat-eaters, or both.
Built and read food chains using arrows.
Explained energy moving from a mango leaf to a caterpillar.
Correctly described effects of removing larvae: fish lack food and algae increase.
Mentioned that dead leaves break down slowly.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animal diets, food-chain arrows, and what changes when one part of a chain is removed. Manav clearly explained the direction of energy in the mango-leaf and caterpillar example and gave connected effects of removing larvae. The plant-eater, meat-eater, and both-foods groups need more practice; there was no later correction recorded. At home, ask Manav to sort a few animals into the three groups and explain one food chain with arrows.
